title: Two Gremlins in a Trenchcoat
notes: Scene-based encounter. Spawns with single GremlinMerc initially. GremlinMerc steals gold during combat. Additional gremlins (FatGremlin, SneakyGremlin) appear via scene mechanics. Gold reward is affected by encounter outcomes: 100% normal, 50% if FatGremlin escapes without gold theft, 0% if gold was stolen by the merc.
